notes: expected_delta.json is captured from the pristine app (never hand-written). subject/study_subject are the behavior under test; audit_log_event records the creation audit trail (audit_date ignored); user_account changes on login (date_lastvisit ignored). audit_user_login is deliberately excluded: auth plumbing with a volatile login_attempt_date, same rationale as mamute's UserSession. enrollment_date is ignored because the form prefills it with today; the flow fills a fixed date but the column format is locale-sensitive.
